label.description: The collection's label for people to read; its key when the schema gives none.

binding.description: `global`: records belong to the app and no robot. `per_robot`: every record belongs to one robot (system field `robot_id`, fixed when the record is created). `one_per_robot`: every robot of the app has exactly one record, which Fleetless creates itself.

read.description: Whether the role may read the records.

create.description: Whether the role may create records.

update.description: `all`: the role may change every record. `own`: only records its user created. `false`: none.

delete.description: `all`: the role may delete every record. `own`: only records its user created. `false`: none.

robot_filter.description: `true` on a collection that belongs to robots (`per_robot`, `one_per_robot`): the role sees and writes only the records of robots a session of the role reaches, whatever the rights above say. `false` on a `global` collection.

description: What one role may do with the records of one collection.
